remarks: Experience refined suburban living within your own walls in this beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath tri-level condo, where generous proportions and thoughtful design elevate everyday comfort. This expansive unit is the true centerpiece - offering bright, open living spaces ideal for both relaxing and entertaining, along with two private decks that extend your living area outdoors for morning coffee, weekend lounging, or hosting guests. An abundance of storage throughout the home ensures everything has its place, keeping your living spaces calm, organized, and effortlessly functional. While the home itself offers a complete lifestyle, its setting just steps from Wilton Center adds an additional layer of convenience. Boutique shops, dining options, and the weekly farmers market are a short stroll away, with scenic walking and biking paths along the Norwalk River Valley Trail providing a peaceful natural escape whenever you need it.Residents of this desirable community also benefit from convenient parking, a meticulously maintained pool, and beautifully landscaped grounds that complement the privacy and comfort of the unit. With easy Metro-North access to New York City, this home blends luxury, convenience, and classic New England charm - with the unit itself providing the perfect foundation for it all.
